name: Bot
tagline: Fast, modular server management bot with premium AI features
changelog: v2.3.0 — AI upgraded: purge_until, purge_from, summarize_ticket, mass_role, get_server_stats. Multi-key AI fallback (GROQ_API_KEY_2/3). Precise system prompt replacing vague registry dump. /purge expanded: amount/user/until/from subcommands. /ticket summarize added.

v2.2.0 — AI tools expanded: create/delete/rename channels, create/delete roles, setup ticket panels, send announcements, create giveaways, create polls. Features registry added. /features command added.
v2.1.0 — AI Assistant audit log (ai_assistant_logs table). /ailog and %ailog commands for admins.

v2.0.0 — Premium AI Assistant (/ai, %ai, no-prefix ai). 12 initial tools: ban, kick, timeout, untimeout, warn, purge, lock, unlock, slowmode, add/remove role, set nickname. Approval flow for destructive actions.
v1.x — Core moderation, economy, ticket system, giveaways, reaction roles, automod, XP/leveling, no-prefix mode.

moderation.title: Moderation
items: Ban members with optional message deletion (1-7 days) — DMs user, logs to mod-log
Kick members — logs to mod-log
Timeout (mute) members up to 28 days — supports 10m, 2h, 7d formats
Remove timeouts
Warn members — warnings persist in database, DM is sent, logged to mod-log
View all warnings per user (/warnings, %warnings)
Clear one or all warnings (/clearwarn, %clearwarn)
Unban members by user ID (/unban, %unban)

purge.title: Purge / Bulk Delete
items: /purge amount <1-100> [@user] — delete last N messages, optional user filter
/purge user @user [count] — delete a specific user's recent messages
/purge until <message_id> — delete all messages back to a message ID (14-day limit)
/purge from <message_id> — delete all messages after a message ID (14-day limit)
All four modes available as prefix commands too (%purge)

channel_management.title: Channel Management
items: Lock channels (deny @everyone SendMessages)
Unlock channels
Set slowmode 0 to 6 hours per message
Create text, voice, category, or announcement channels
Delete channels
Rename channels
Set or clear channel topics

role_management.title: Role Management
items: Create roles (name, color, hoist, mentionable)
Delete roles
Add and remove roles from individual members
mass_role: add/remove a role from all members with a given filter role (up to 150)
Set or reset member nicknames
Reaction roles — members self-assign roles by reacting to messages

tickets.title: Ticket System
items: Full ticket setup — auto-creates category and transcript channel if not configured
Post ticket panel with Open Ticket button in any channel
Each ticket creates a private channel visible only to the opener and support role
Full message transcripts auto-saved to transcript channel on close
Add or remove users from active tickets
/ticket summarize — AI reads up to 500 messages and posts an intelligent summary
View ticket system config (/ticket config)
AI can set up the full ticket system and post the panel in a single natural-language command

giveaways.title: Giveaways
items: Start giveaways with prize, duration, winner count
Optional role requirement (only members with that role can win)
Optional minimum account age filter
Bonus entries for a specific role
End, cancel, extend, or reroll giveaways
List all active giveaways in the server

polls.title: Polls
items: Create polls with a question and up to 10 options
Members vote by reacting with numbered emoji
Works in any channel the bot has access to

economy.title: Economy & Levels
items: XP earned from chatting (1 XP per message, 60s cooldown)
Levels calculated from XP — view with /rank or %rank
Coins earned from daily rewards — use /daily or %daily
Daily login streak tracked and displayed
Full profile card (/profile or %profile)
Server leaderboard (/leaderboard)

automod.title: AutoMod (Premium)
items: Word filter — define banned words/phrases
Anti-spam — auto-delete if 5+ messages in 5 seconds
Mention flood protection — configurable limit
Excessive caps detection — configurable percentage
All violations logged to a dedicated AutoMod log channel

utilities.title: Utilities
items: Server info, user info, avatar, banner
Math calculator, color preview, translate text
8ball, coinflip, dice — fun commands
AFK mode — bot replies on mention while AFK
Snipe — recover last deleted message in channel
Reminders — set a reminder for later
Custom embed builder (/embed)

server_setup.title: Server Setup
items: Custom bot prefix per server (/setprefix)
No-prefix mode — bot responds without any prefix at all
No-prefix access control — restrict no-prefix to specific roles/users
Custom embed color and footer text for server branding
Welcome messages — configured channel and custom message
Mod log channel — all ban/kick/mute/warn/member events sent automatically

ai_assistant.title: AI Assistant (Premium)
items: Natural-language commands — describe what to do and the bot executes it

27 tools: ban, kick, timeout, warn, purge (4 modes), lock/unlock, slowmode, channel CRUD, role CRUD, set nickname, mass role, send announcement, setup ticket panel, summarize ticket, create giveaway, create poll, get server stats
Approve/Cancel confirmation flow for all destructive actions (ban, kick, purge, delete, lock, announce, mass_role)
All runs recorded to an audit log — query with /ailog
Works via /ai, %ai, or no-prefix 'ai ...'
Multi-key fallback — supports GROQ_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY_2, GROQ_API_KEY_3 (rotates automatically on credit exhaustion)
Powered by Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) or OpenAI — configurable via AI_ASSISTANT_MODEL env var
Precise system prompt with exact command docs, limits, and explicit cannot-do list
